questions.question: What is the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm?
questions.explanation: Area of triangle = (1/2) × base × height = (1/2) × 10 × 6 = 30 cm².
steps: 1. Recall the formula: Area = (1/2) × base × height.
2. Identify base = 10 cm and height = 6 cm.
questions.fastStrategy: Triangle area = half the product of base and height.
